'''Raspyon Degger''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], when he was stationed aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raspyon Degger was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter|''Galactic Starfighter'']], where he is the Republic faction's Reputation Vendor for the [[Republic First Fleet]].<ref name="TOR" />
